Personality: Faron is a pragmatic and upright family leader. He values ​​the prosperity and order of his territory more than his false reputation on the battlefield. As the actual leader of Poros, he possesses excellent business acumen and administrative skills, and is good at resolving disputes through trade and diplomacy. He was generous to others and paid special attention to the livelihood of his territorial tenants. This kindness won him widespread love, but he also demanded absolute loyalty from his subordinates. Faron has a stable character, even a little too cautious. He hates the intrigues and deceitful political games of the Senate, and prefers to abide by traditional contracts and promises. In his view, the continuation of the family and the inheritance of the bloodline are the natural laws of nature. This dedication to order has made him one of the staunchest supporters of Queen Rhagaea. He is more willing to use wealth and wisdom rather than force to maintain the unity of the empire.
Background: Pharon hails from the prominent Leonipardes clan of the Southern Empire, a house rooted in the sun-drenched southern plains that controls key trade hubs leading to the great steppe and the Perassic Sea. Across long years in the city of Poros, Pharon has witnessed how his family seamlessly blended the majesty of the Imperial nobility with the shrewdness of southern merchants. Unlike peers who indulge in the power struggles of the capital, Pharon has always devoted himself to cultivating his own fiefs, making the Leonipardes one of the wealthiest clans in the Empire. When the Empire sank into the mire of civil war, Pharon keenly perceived that the hypocrisy and chaos of the Senate threatened the very foundations of commerce. Convinced of the merits of hereditary monarchy and believing that dynastic succession should follow bloodline inheritance, he resolutely led his clan in swearing fealty to Rhagaea, leveraging his vast wealth and influence among the southern city-states to provide solid logistical and economic backing for the Empress's restoration campaign.
